## Two trial programmes

| Programme | Counts / dates | Issuer | Tier | Note |
|-----------|----------------|--------|------|------|
| **[Regulatory Sandbox](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000179.htm)** | Apps from 2024-11-13; **38** of **72** selected (PR **2025-03-20**) | WG / TLB | T2 | [AC-013](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_E.pdf) = BVLOS in Sandbox (PDF 2025-12-31, T1) |
| **[Regulatory Sandbox X](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400912.htm)** | Launch **2025-11-24**; batches UTM **15** / unconventional aircraft **4** / shared **5** / others **9**; cross-boundary **OPEN** | CE / WG / TLB | T1/T2 | [AC-017](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-017.pdf) = cross-boundary in Sandbox X (PDF 2026-04-24, T1) |

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
**Regulatory Sandbox** — English: “The Government received Regulatory Sandbox pilot project proposals from 72 applicants, and after review by the Working Group on Developing LAE, 38 of them are among the first batch of pilot projects to be rolled out” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000179.htm))\
[「政府共接獲由72個申請者提交的「監管沙盒」試點項目申請，經發展低空經濟工作組審閱後，其中38項成為首批推展的試點項目」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000178.htm))\
English: “Permission for Small Unmanned Aircraft Beyond Visual Line of Sight Operations within the Context of Regulatory Sandbox” ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_E.pdf))\
[「「監管沙盒」框架下小型無人機超視距操作許可」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_C.pdf))

**Regulatory Sandbox X** — English: “The launch event of the low-altitude economy \"Regulatory Sandbox X\" was held today (November 24), with an aim to further promoting the development of low-altitude economy in Hong Kong and exploring innovative applications.”…“The goal of \"Regulatory Sandbox X\" is to handle more complex scenarios, such as cross-boundary low altitude drones, unconventional aircraft designed for passenger-carrying, and integrated operation platforms.” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400912.htm))\
[「低空經濟「監管沙盒X」啟動禮今日（十一月二十四日）舉行，旨在進一步推動香港的低空經濟發展，並探索創新應用場景。」…「是升級版的監管沙盒，旨在處理更複雜的場景，例如跨境低空無人機、可載人航空器和綜合運營平台等。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400779.htm))
:::

> Regulatory Sandbox ≠ Sandbox X. Counts are **38** + Sandbox X module batches (15+4+5+9 = **33**) — never blended.

**~HK\$350bn by 2050** — English: “Based on the latest publicly available data, the industry value added of the LAE in Hong Kong will reach approximately HK\$ 350 billion in 2050, with the majority of value generated in supporting services.” ([source](https://ourhkfoundation.org.hk/en/events/%E3%80%8A%E6%8C%AF%E7%BF%85%E5%95%9F%E8%88%AA-%E2%80%94-%E9%96%8B%E5%89%B5%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BD%8E%E7%A9%BA%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E6%96%B0%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E3%80%8B%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E7%99%BC%E5%B8%83%E6%9C%83))\
[「根據本報告撰寫時的最新公開數據估算，預計到2050年，本港低空經濟產業的增加價值將達到約3,500億港元，而其中大部分來自配套服務。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://ourhkfoundation.org.hk/tc/events/%E3%80%8A%E6%8C%AF%E7%BF%85%E5%95%9F%E8%88%AA-%E2%80%94-%E9%96%8B%E5%89%B5%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BD%8E%E7%A9%BA%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E6%96%B0%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E3%80%8B%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E7%99%BC%E5%B8%83%E6%9C%83))

**Sandbox 38 / 72** — English: “The Government received Regulatory Sandbox pilot project proposals from 72 applicants, and after review by the Working Group on Developing LAE, 38 of them are among the first batch of pilot projects to be rolled out” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000179.htm))\
[「政府共接獲由72個申請者提交的「監管沙盒」試點項目申請，經發展低空經濟工作組審閱後，其中38項成為首批推展的試點項目」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000178.htm))

**Sandbox X 15+4+5+9** — English: “(i) 15 pilot projects under the UTM system demonstrations module, (ii) a first batch of four pilot projects under the unconventional aircraft module; (iii) a first batch of five pilot projects under the multiple applications/users shared-platform module; and (iv) a first batch of nine pilot projects under the others module have been selected for implementation in phases.” ([source](https://www.tlb.gov.hk/eng/highlights/transport/low-altitude.html))\
[「經發展低空經濟工作組審閱後，已選定(i) 15個UTM系統演示試點項目；(ii) 首批四個非傳統航空器試點項目；(iii) 首批五個多場景／多用戶共享平台試點項目，以及(iv) 首批九個其他試點項目予以分階段推行。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.tlb.gov.hk/tc/highlights/transport/low-altitude.html))

**>140 regularised projects (PA 2026 ¶137)** — English: “The low-altitude economy (LAE) \"Regulatory Sandbox\" has facilitated the regularisation of diverse applications. Over 140 regularised projects have been approved” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2026/en/chapter3.html))\
[「低空經濟「監管沙盒」已促成多項應用恆常化，至今批准恆常化項目超過140個」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2026/tc/chapter3.html))

**about 10 Sandbox X projects begun testing** — English: “About 10 projects have begun testing, including unmanned aircraft traffic management system demonstrations and unconventional aircraft.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2026/en/chapter3.html))\
[「現已有約十個項目開展測試，涵蓋無人機交通管理系統演示及非傳統航空器等。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2026/tc/chapter3.html))

:::

**Allowed wording** (OHKF, *Taking Flight…*, Sep 2025; an OHKF projection, not a government figure):

> OHKF (Sep 2025) projects ~HK$350 billion **industry value-added** in Hong Kong by 2050 (majority from supporting services).

**Banned:** “Government estimates HK$350bn…” / classroom tickets, HHI, CASK, flights / vendor “GBA trillion.”

## What not to write

- Do not write that the government estimates HK$350 billion.
- No published Action Plan text, no Hong Kong vertiport statute, and no completed cross-boundary corridor.
- Smart TMS from **2028** and >150 kg drafting **within 2027** are PA Annex work indicators, not effective law dates.
- Still open: a Working Group instrument beyond the Policy Address and the first meeting; Cap. 448G s.12(2)(c) commencement; Pigovian drone taxes.
